column1: In an SSMS graphical SELECT plan, rows generally flow {{c1::right to left}}, toward the root SELECT operator.
column2:
Follow the connecting arrows from the data-access operators toward the result.
Review source

column1: The width of connecting arrows in an SSMS execution plan represents {{c1::the number of rows flowing between operators}}.
column2:
Inspect the arrow properties for row counts rather than treating width as elapsed time.
Review source

column1: Operator cost percentages in an actual execution plan remain {{c1::optimizer estimates}}, not measured percentages of elapsed time.
column2:
Use actual runtime metrics to assess what happened during execution.
Review source

column1: Generate estimated XML plans without executing subsequent queries with {{c1::SET SHOWPLAN_XML ON;}}
column2:
Run this SET statement in its own batch and turn it OFF afterward.
Review source

column1: Execute queries and return XML plans with runtime information using {{c1::SET STATISTICS XML ON;}}
column2:
Turn the option OFF after capturing the plans you need.

column1: For a sys.dm_exec_query_stats row with executions, average CPU time is {{c1::total_worker_time / execution_count}}.
column2:
The result is CPU time per execution, not elapsed time per execution.
Review source

The reported unit is finer than the measurement accuracy, which is only to milliseconds.
